environment.timing_scope: Local query, complete fetch and Python result dictionaries; downloads/build/profiles excluded

independent_skill_exercise.status: Completed read-only using the entrypoint, references and bundled headway query before proposed improvements were disclosed.
independent_skill_exercise.task: Route 66 weekday peak deployment and pattern-specific regularity; Yellow/Blue speed suitability; recurring planning reports.
independent_skill_exercise.cta_train_source_timestamps: Absent; even exact-coordinate poll-based movement contains implausible jumps.
independent_skill_exercise.assessment: Useful for retrospective feed QA, observed deployment, exploratory fixed-pattern regularity, and movement anomaly investigation. No validated train speed, passenger wait, schedule adherence or cancellation conclusion is supported.

improvements_from_testing: Declared pytz for Python timestamp fetches.
Anchored archive-date extraction to the NDJSON filename, excluding ISO dates in parent directories.
Added DST-aware all-mode daily calendar coverage and hourly expected-minute denominators.
Added executable guarded route/line movement diagnostics with adjacency and conflicting-poll exclusions.
Documented small headway samples, absent route-hours, archival versus live scope, and a recurring planning-report menu.
Added full file-comparison, DST/repeated-hour and movement regression tests to offline checks and CI.
limitations: Timing pass ran after ingestion completed; three warm repetitions and a first execution, without OS cache flushing. Query fetch and Python result construction included.
No controlled cold-disk, remote-object, concurrent-client, production-tail-latency or multi-year test.
Daily archive observations are retrospective; mode-level missing minutes can reflect inactive service, and bus coverage gaps do not prove collection failure.
Pattern-specific headways use within-hour truncation, gate heuristics and incomplete individual-passage detection; schedules and common-stop geometry were not supplied.
No with/without-skill LLM benchmark or automatic-trigger accuracy test.
The original Linux historical performance table is preserved separately and uses some different query definitions.
